about.kicker: EY · SAP Certified Fiori Application Developer · Clean Core & ABAP Cloud
about.headline: From GAP to go-live: RAP, Fiori and BTP on greenfield ECC and S/4HANA projects.
about.body:
Senior ABAP Fiori Developer at EY, in the software factory for greenfield ECC and S/4HANA projects, where I have delivered 20+ GAPs from scratch. I run the full cycle — GAP analysis, technical specification, sprint and functional delivery — with no modification to standard.

On the front end, I build Fiori/SAPUI5 experiences (freestyle and templates) aligned with Design Guidelines. On the back end, I model with RAP, ABAP Cloud and CDS Views, prioritizing solid OData contracts, performance and traceability.

On SAP BTP, I deliver solutions with CAP, Integration Suite and HANA Cloud. I have led projects with offline operations (HAT/Asset Manager) and production support in ECC and S/4HANA environments.

ey.role: Senior ABAP Fiori Developer (RAP, BTP, Freestyle, CAP, ABAP Cloud)
highlights: 20+ GAPs delivered from scratch at EY’s software factory, on greenfield ECC and S/4HANA projects — from analysis to functional delivery, within the sprint calendar agreed with the end client.
Production of complete technical documentation (ET, TUT and specification artifacts), organizing requirements and functional gaps before and throughout the development cycle.
Full stack SAP development with RAP, ABAP Cloud, Fiori Freestyle, SAP CAP and SAP BTP, strictly applying Clean Core principles and side-by-side extensibility.

subtopics.title: Discovery, GAPs and delivery governance
items: Analysis and organization of functional and technical GAPs, translating business needs into development scope prioritized by sprint.
Production of Technical Specifications (ET) and Technical Unit Tests (TUT), maintaining traceability between requirement, implementation and validation.
End-to-end traceability across technical specs (ET), unit tests (TUT) and transports (TR), keeping the sprint cycle auditable by the end client.

subtopics.title: Greenfield development and Clean Core architecture
items: Build of ABAP Cloud objects and RAP services with CDS Views and OData, prioritizing stable contracts and decoupling across layers.
Development of Fiori Freestyle applications and SAP CAP solutions on SAP BTP, integrated with the ECC/S/4HANA back end following extensibility standards.
Architecture decisions guided by Clean Core — no standard modification — ensuring upgradeability and adherence to SAP best practices.

highlights: Development and support of custom and standard SAP solutions in ECC and S/4HANA landscapes, using SAP Fiori UI5 Freestyle, JavaScript, SAP BTP, Azure DevOps, Web IDE, SAP Business Application Studio and SAP Mobile Hybrid.
Development and maintenance of SAP Fiori UI5 Freestyle applications, ensuring adherence to SAP Fiori Design Guidelines (SAP BAS, VS Code and Web IDE).
Modeled CDS Views and RAP services consumed by Fiori Elements applications running in production at SIPAL, BRF and São Salvador Alimentos.
AMS support: diagnosed incidents across CDS Views, OData services and ABAP logic, delivering fixes through controlled transports to production.
Focal Freestyle front-end developer on the SAP implementation project under SAP Activate methodology.
Hybrid Fiori Elements + Freestyle applications: standard templates for list screens, custom code only on exception flows.
Managed the development lifecycle in Azure DevOps, from backlog to transport.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: SIPAL — Agricultural Optimization
items: Development and optimization of SAPUI5/Fiori apps to modernize agricultural management processes.
Data exposure via CDS Views and RAP with robust OData services, reducing coupling and rework across layers.
UX and performance improvements focused on fast execution for field and back-office teams.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: BRF — AppGrãos
items: Hybrid SAPUI5 (HAT) multichannel app — web, mobile, online and offline — for commodity purchasing, running in the field with no signal and syncing on reconnect.
OData integration over an SAP database holding millions of records, with validation and transactional traceability on every sync.
Delivery and evolution of critical flows (freight calculation, contract validations) executable by the buyer directly in the field.

subtopics.title: São Salvador Alimentos (SSA) — SAP Technical Support (ABAP, Fiori and Asset Manager)
items: Provided support and continuous improvement for SAP solutions, focusing on reliability, traceability and delivery agility.
Resolved functional and technical tickets with fixes and enhancements in CDS Views, OData services and ABAP logic.
Maintained and evolved Fiori freestyle apps and custom extensions over standard SAP modules, aligning the system to client processes.
Worked with Eclipse ADT and transports via TASK/TR, maintaining delivery discipline and impact control.
Delivered SAP Asset Manager configurations and technical extensions to align the app with maintenance and asset management flows.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: LIGGA
items: Support and evolution of SAP solutions, focusing on technical fixes, stability, and continuous improvement in production.

highlights: Developed and maintained MVC-based web systems for auctions, focused on operational flow and consistent UX.
Built integrations with external APIs (WhatsApp, Instagram, and others) and business rules connected to SQL/MySQL databases.
Delivered responsive, performant interfaces in Vue.js with stable back-end integration and continuous product evolution.

ztg.role: SAPUI5 Consultant / JavaScript Full Stack (Fiori, BTP Neo/BAS)
highlights: Developed SAPUI5 freestyle applications and Fiori templates for ECC and S/4HANA landscapes, aligned with Fiori Design Guidelines and focused on usability and performance.
Worked on SAP BTP (NEO) using Web IDE and SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), covering development, deployment, and support.
Integrated with SAP ECC and S/4HANA back ends via OData, keeping contracts clear and layers decoupled across UI, services, and data.
Delivered custom components/controls and contributed full stack in JavaScript/Node.js and front-end (React/HTML/CSS) when required by the project.

subtopics.title: Project: Vehicle Management Cockpit (ACCÇÃO)
items: Modular SAPUI5 freestyle applications for fleet management (drivers, vehicles, and operational data) consuming OData exposed from ECC/S/4HANA.
Persistence and querying on SAP HANA Cloud, focused on responsiveness and consistent data for decision-making.
SAP BTP integrations and validations to orchestrate flows between the Fiori front end and ECC/S/4HANA back end, with end-to-end traceability.

subtopics.title: Domvs IT — Building the SAP cell and greenfield products on SAP BTP
items: Strategic contribution to structuring the initial SAP cell, including technical prospecting and solution architecture across ECC, S/4HANA and BTP.
Built greenfield products on SAP BTP with SAP CAP as the core layer, delivered through SAP Business Application Studio (BAS).
Integration with ECC/S/4HANA landscapes via OData and iFlows, applying Clean Core, data modeling on SAP HANA Cloud and decisions targeting decoupling and scalability.

highlights: Developed and maintained systems for bars, restaurants, and local businesses (order tabs, NFC-e issuance, and fiscal routines).
Built fiscal and management reports (e.g., DRE and Sintegra), focused on data consistency and decision support.
Delivered client-specific customizations, technical support, and small integrations on top of MySQL, with web deliveries (HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React/Vue) as needed.
Implemented targeted layout and usability improvements with HTML/CSS/JavaScript, prioritizing visual clarity and UI consistency.
Supported the team with focused front-end deliveries.
